project_type: Create React App single-page application, vanilla JS client
build_system: react-scripts (CRA v5). A syncSamplingGuide.js script runs before build/dev. No TypeScript.
test_framework: react-scripts test (Jest + React Testing Library). No existing test files for App.jsx.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from the client directory. The build must complete with 0 errors. Warnings about unused variables are acceptable. No unit tests exist; verification is a clean compile.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/samplingGuide.js is generated by scripts/syncSamplingGuide.js from samplingguide.json. It is regenerated on every build/dev start and should not be hand-edited.
environment_constraints: All production code lives in a single file: src/App.jsx (7014 lines). styles.css is 3761 lines. Never split App.jsx into multiple files — the project convention is one monolithic component file. Do not restart any dev server.
contribution_requirements: All edits stay within src/App.jsx and src/styles.css. No new npm packages. The build artifact lives in build/ but is not committed — only src/ changes matter.
key_patterns: 1. State declared inside the App() component function around line 3010-3020. 2. Analytics useMemo at line 4841 closes at line 4916, dep array is [submissions] (will change to [analyticsSubmissions]). 3. buildAnalyticsTimeline() is a module-level function at line 1704. 4. AnalyticsBar and AnalyticsDonut and MonthChart are module-level components at lines 2735, 2801, 2906. 5. JSX render for the analytics tab begins ~line 6157 (adminTab === 'analytics'). 6. The analytics-card-full (Top generic names) closes at line ~6641. The analytics-shell is at line ~6642. 7. CSS analytics classes run from line 2735 to 3287 in styles.css. Responsive overrides for analytics are at lines ~3429-3438 (900px), ~3513-3524 (640px), and ~3696-3711 (480px). 8. ANALYTICS_DATE_MODES constant at line 24. clearAdminSession resets state at line 3494. 9. Field names on submission objects: s.status, s.decisionRemark, s.dosageForm, s.productSampleAnswers?.dosage_form, s.productSampleAnswers?.country_of_origin, s.sampleReceivedDate, s.takenToLabDate, s.labReportReceivedDate, s.createdAt. Note: clientSubmittedAt does NOT exist in the data model — use s.createdAt as the 'submission' timestamp for the first turnaround segment.
directory_structure: samples/client/src/ contains App.jsx (entire app), styles.css (all styles), index.js (entry), index.css (resets). samples/client/build/ is the compiled output (not committed). .agents/tasks/ contains planning artifacts.
